description:
Company Description

Welcome to Avenues São Paulo! Since our doors opened in August 2018, we've been on a mission to provide a truly transformative educational experience. Through immersive English language learning and dynamic interdisciplinary projects, we prepare our students to become future worldwise leaders uniquely equipped to understand and solve global-scale problems. As part of the Nord Anglia Education network, we're proud to stand alongside Avenues New York, shaping the future of education together. With a vibrant community of over 1100 students, ranging from as young as 18 months old through to graduation, our campus buzzes with a culture of innovation, creativity, collaboration, and state-of-the-art technology. Join us as we embark on a journey of lifelong learning and growth and discover why there's no place quite like Avenues São Paulo.

Job Description

This role blends analytical skills with a strong understanding of digital content and marketing to create, plan, implement, and optimize content strategies that drive brand positioning and enrollment growth. Reporting directly to the Content Marketing Manager, this role is integral to supporting the Marketing team at the São Paulo campus, ensuring that all content aligns with Avenues’ mission and branding philosophies, with strong ownership over Avenues São Paulo’s digital content presence and a high standard of editorial judgment and strategic thinking.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Responsible for developing and managing implementation schedules and strategic actions to ensure timely and effective content delivery across channels (including social media, email campaigns, website, and blog articles) in alignment with overall marketing objectives.
  • Monitors, collects, and analyzes performance data (traffic, engagement, conversions, etc.) across channels to produce comprehensive reports with actionable insights and recommendations for content optimization and campaign improvements.
  • Creates, publishes, and manages written and visual content tailored to different audiences, in the form of website updates, blog articles, email marketing, social media posts/messages, campaigns etc, ensuring alignment with Avenues’ brand, tone, and marketing objectives.
  • Owns the quality, consistency, and effectiveness of digital content across platforms, ensuring high editorial standards and strategic alignment with enrollment and brand objectives.
  • Conducts competitive research and monitors public sentiment and digital trends to identify opportunities for differentiation, growth, and audience engagement.
  • Manages and maintains a content calendar to ensure timely, strategic, and consistent content delivery aligned with marketing initiatives and key admissions dates and events.
  • Supports multimedia content production, including video and photo shooting and editing, to deliver high-quality, impactful digital assets.
  • Monitors and manages the online community by responding to comments, messages, and inquiries, fostering positive interactions and building an engaged digital audience.
  • Collaborates with external PR and marketing agencies to ensure alignment of our messaging, strategy, and goals.
  • Engages with faculty and academic teams to understand classroom experiences and learning practices, translating them into accurate, compelling, and authentic content narratives.
  • Collaborates closely with Admissions and Marketing to interpret content performance in relation to enrollment goals, supporting data-informed decisions across the admissions funnel.
  • Continuously monitors trends in content marketing, social media, and digital analytics, translating insights and performance data into strategic evolution of content formats, channels, and narratives.

Qualifications

  • Fluent in both Portuguese and English.
  • Strong editorial judgment and the ability to write, edit, and adapt high-quality content fluently in both English and Portuguese for different audiences and channels.
  • Solid experience in a Marketing and Social Media role.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Suite, including Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, and Premiere.
  • A degree in Marketing, Communications or a related field is preferred.
  • Strong Verbal and Written Communication Skills.
  • Experience using CRM and analytics tools (such as HubSpot and Salesforce) to inform content strategy and performance optimization.
  • Experience with Google Ads/Analytics, Meta, CRM, and SEO.
  • Extreme attention to detail and organization with proven project management skills, from ideation to completion in a fast-growing, quick-moving environment, and the ability to prioritize.
  • A desire to work as part of a highly collaborative and can-do team, a hands-on, entrepreneurial approach, and eager to roll up your sleeves and tackle challenges.
  • A results-oriented, collaborative approach to project management.
  • Experience in education is desirable but not required. A strong interest in school routines and innovative educational methodologies is essential.

Additional Information

Avenues is deeply committed to diversity, equity and inclusion throughout our organization. We strive to uphold a culture in which every colleague feels that they belong, are trusted, and are valued. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, and strongly encourage candidates from traditionally underrepresented communities or groups to apply. Avenues offers competitive compensation and a generous benefits package.

title: Analista Programador Java
description:
BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.

Ei Profissional venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!

  • O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

  • O que você deve ter?

Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Desenvolver e evoluir aplicações backend utilizando Java (11+) e Spring Boot .
  • Projetar e implementar APIs RESTful escaláveis e seguras.
  • Construir soluções cloud-native utilizando AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB).
  • Participar de decisões de arquitetura e definição de padrões de desenvolvimento .
  • Implementar testes automatizados (unitários e integração).
  • Aplicar boas práticas de engenharia como Clean Code, Code Review, observabilidade e performance .
  • Colaborar com times de Produto, QA, DevOps e Arquitetura .

Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida com Java (11+) .
  • Conhecimento avançado em Spring Boot e seus módulos (Spring Data, Security, Cloud) .
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e NoSQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL, DynamoDB, MongoDB).
  • Vivência com AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, API Gateway, CloudWatch, IAM).
  • Experiência com CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins ou similares).
  • Conhecimento em Docker e conteinerização .
  • Experiência com mensageria (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS ou SNS).
  • Experiência com testes automatizados (JUnit, Mockito) .

⭐ Diferenciais

  • Experiência com Terraform ou CloudFormation .
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de microsserviços e event-driven .
  • Certificações AWS .
  • Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade (Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, New Relic) .

O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 etapas:

- Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

- Mobilidade Interna: Você quer um novo rumo profissional? Aqui dentro de casa temos diversas opções diferentes e o programa de mobilidade interna, que te permite mudar de área, por exemplo.

- Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

- Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Remote AI Quality Analyst (Japanese) - 62136
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.

Role Overview:

As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalization feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.

Key Qualifications:

  • Japanese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Japanese with a high degree of comp, as Japanese is the focus language for this project.
  • Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.

Description:

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions.

Your day-to-day work will involve:

  • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences.
  • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied.
  • Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
  • Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic "overnarrating".
  • Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
  • Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
  • Extracting and verifying "Debug Info" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized.
  • Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.

Education & Experience:

  • BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).
  • Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.

Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and minimum 30 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
  • Engagement type: Contractor
  • Engagement Length: 3 months

After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

title: Analista de PLD Pleno
description:
Sobre a empresa:

A S3 CACEIS é uma empresa global, com a tradição e solidez de dois dos maiores grupos bancários internacionais - Santander e Crédit Agricole, que oferece Serviços de Administração Fiduciária e Custódia de acordo com os perfis, segmentos e desafios de cada cliente.

Contamos com um time especialista em transformar grandes desafios em oportunidades ainda maiores, composto por mais de 7.000 colaboradores, em 17 países.

Sobre a área:

A área de PLD/FTP (Prevenção à Lavagem de Dinheiro e ao Financiamento do Terrorismo) atua na proteção da integridade do sistema financeiro, identificando e mitigando riscos relacionados ao uso indevido de produtos e serviços financeiros.

Quais serão suas principais responsabilidades:

  • Realizar análises de KYC (Conheça seu Cliente) e apoiar processos de onboarding e revisão cadastral, garantindo: validação documental, pesquisas reputacionais, mídia negativa, listas restritivas e sanções.
  • Elaborar apresentações com visão estratégica sobre os clientes de Alto Risco.
  • Conduzir análise de alertas de monitoramento transacional, avaliando indícios de operações atípicas, compatibilidade e origem de recursos.
  • Avaliar controles e processos de prevenção à lavagem de dinheiro, identificando oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Interagir com diferentes áreas da instituição para coleta de informações e alinhamento de temas relacionados a risco de PLD/FTP.
  • Atuar com agilidade em ambiente dinâmico, com senso de priorização, cumprimento de prazos e gerenciamento de múltiplas demandas.

O que buscamos em você:

  • Ensino Superior completo em Administração, Direito, Economia, Contabilidade, Relações Internacionais ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência em PLD/FT, com foco em KYC e KYP (de preferência no setor financeiro ou de investimentos).
  • Conhecimento das regulamentações do mercado financeiro e de capitais voltadas ao tema de PLD/FTP.
  • Conhecimento avançado em Excel, Word e PowerPoint.
  • Inglês e/ou espanhol serão considerados diferenciais.
  • Cursos ou certificações relacionados à área de PLD/FTP, Compliance, Gestão de Riscos ou Prevenção à Lavagem de Dinheiro serão considerados um diferencial.

title: Merchant Risk Management Expert
description:
As a Merchant Risk Management Expert , you will be the strategic gatekeeper for our merchant ecosystem in Brazil. Your mission is to oversee the entire merchant lifecycle, from initial qualification to dynamic, real-time monitoring. You will play a pivotal role in balancing business growth with robust risk mitigation, ensuring that our operations not only meet but exceed the regulatory standards of the Brazilian Central Bank.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lifecycle Risk Ownership: Lead the end-to-end risk management process for merchants, including rigorous qualification reviews, risk assessments, and proactive dynamic monitoring to ensure ecosystem health.
  • Localized Policy Architecture: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and implement risk control policies specifically tailored to the Brazilian market, ensuring 100% alignment with local regulations (BCB) and global standards.
  • Strategic Interfacing: Act as the primary risk consultant for our internal business teams and external merchant partners. You will represent the "voice of risk" in commercial discussions, ensuring a smooth balance between security and scalability.
  • System Innovation: Drive the optimization of our risk systems and tool upgrades. You will identify gaps in current processes and lead the implementation of technological enhancements to improve service efficiency and detection quality.

Requirements

  • Expertise: Minimum of 3+ years of experience in risk management, specifically within cross-border e-commerce or international acquiring institutions .
  • Regulatory Mastery: Deep, up-to-date knowledge of Brazilian local policies and regulations (Central Bank). You must have the ability to swiftly pivot strategies in response to regulatory changes.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree or higher in Finance, Computer Science, Economics, or a related field.
  • Communication & Culture: Proven ability to collaborate across diverse, global teams. You are comfortable navigating cross-cultural environments and can translate complex risk data into actionable business insights.
  • Language: Fluent English is mandatory, as it is our primary working language for global collaboration.
  • Problem Solver: A resilient and pragmatic mindset, with a track record of resolving complex, high-stakes risk issues.

Why Ant International?

We are a global leader in digital payments and financial technology. Joining us means working at the intersection of massive scale and local impact. You will have the opportunity to build the future of financial inclusion while working with some of the most advanced risk management technologies in the world.

title: Orientador (A)

Sobre o MUB3

O MUB3 é o primeiro museu da América Latina dedicado a contar a história do mercado de capitais e da Bolsa. A área de Orientação do MUB3 é responsável por acolher, informar e guiar o público durante a visita ao museu. title: Gerente de MSS (Managed Security Services)
description:
Head de Capítulo - Engenharia de Detecção e Resposta

Nossa operação de Managed Security Services (MSS) alcançou um novo patamar de maturidade e escala no Brasil. Para sustentar esse crescimento acelerado e manter o nível de excelência exigido por clientes de ambientes críticos, estamos evoluindo nossa estrutura organizacional para o modelo de Capítulos de Especialidade.

Nesse contexto, buscamos profissionais preparados para assumir um papel de liderança técnica e estratégica, atuando como Head de Capítulo, com responsabilidade direta sobre pessoas, qualidade técnica, evolução de capacidades e interface com clientes e stakeholders globais.

A UPX é referência latino-americana em proteção de borda, observabilidade e Managed Security Services, com mais de 22 anos protegendo infraestruturas críticas e operações de alta disponibilidade.

1. Competências Técnicas

✅ Experiência em MSSP:

  • Atuação comprovada em operação ou estruturação de Provedores de Serviços de Segurança Gerenciados;
  • Familiaridade com modelos de SLA, processos operacionais, precificação e métricas.

✅ Conhecimento técnico em soluções:

  • Crowdstrike: Endpoint Protection, EDR/XDR, gestão de incidentes;
  • Google Chronicle SIEM: Coleta, retenção e análise de logs e eventos de segurança;
  • Soluções complementares: Firewall, WAF, Zero Trust, IAM, entre outras.

✅ Operação e gestão de SOC:

  • Gestão de equipes SOC (Tier 1, 2 e 3);
  • Domínio em processos de triagem, investigação e resposta a incidentes.

✅ Inteligência de ameaças:

  • OSINT, plataformas como Recorded Future, MISP, Anomali, etc.

✅ Estruturas de segurança cibernética:

  • NIST CSF, MITRE ATT&CK, ISO 27001/27002, CIS Controls.

✅ Conformidade e regulatório:

  • LGPD, GDPR, PCI DSS, HIPAA, SOC2.

✅ Gestão de Incidentes Críticos:

  • Experiência com ransomware, APTs, DDoS, vazamentos de dados, etc.

2. Habilidades Gerenciais e Comportamentais

  • Visão estratégica e foco em novos negócios;
  • Liderança de equipes técnicas, recrutamento e desenvolvimento de talentos;
  • Apoio à equipe comercial com visão técnica e presença em negociações;
  • Comunicação eficaz com diferentes níveis (clientes, diretoria, stakeholders);
  • Resiliência, flexibilidade e capacidade de entrega sob pressão;
  • Gestão de múltiplos projetos com metodologias ágeis ou tradicionais.

3. Qualificações Obrigatórias e Desejáveis

Obrigatórias:

  • Formação superior completa em Engenharia (qualquer especialidade);

Desejáveis:

  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em Cibersegurança ou Gestão de TI.
  • Certificações de segurança (desejáveis, mas não obrigatórias): CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CISA, Crowdstrike Falcon, Google Chronicle, SANS/GIAC, CTIA.

Sobre a UPX:

A UPX está há duas décadas no mercado, é referência em mitigação de ataques DDoS, e destaque no monitoramento, identificação, tratamento, prevenção de incidentes e entrega de conteúdo (CDN e Streaming) com elevado desempenho. Está presente em Campinas (SP) e Miami (EUA), tem em seu portfólio grandes clientes do setor bancário e financeiro, operadoras de telecom e provedores de internet (ISP).

Atua combatendo ataques, vulnerabilidades e ameaças cibernéticas com apoio de um time técnico de Segurança da Informação e Engenharia de Redes que operam por meio de SOC (Security Operations Center), NOC (Network Operations Center) e Scrubbing Centers (Centros de Mitigação).

title: Estagiário de finanças

Para nós 10 minutos é tempo de sobra para você preparar ou receber refeições deliciosas e saudáveis!

A Cumbuca Boa é um e-commerce que oferece comida ultracongelada, saudável e deliciosa. Que nasceu para democratizar o acesso a uma alimentação de qualidade e quebrar de vez o tabu da comida congelada, acredite se quiser… Ou melhor, experimente e dê sua opinião!

A Piadina Romagnola é o resultado de um sonho antigo de construir uma empresa no ramo da alimentação. Nela oferecemos um sanduíche delicioso e tradicional, a Piadina, muito mais saudável e equilibrado que as opções mais comuns. Fundada em 2012 com a primeira unidade no Morumbi Shopping, atua hoje em 14 unidades localizadas em alguns do melhores pontos da cidade de São Paulo, atendendo cerca de 80.000 clientes/mês.

Tanto na Cumbuca quanto na Piadina nossa missão é uma só: encantar nossos clientes todos os dias através de uma alimentação deliciosa, saudável e prática.

Nossos principais ingredientes são amor e carinho.

Gostamos de proporcionar o bem aos outros, seja através da nossa comida, seja através da nossa forma de trabalhar.

Se você sonha com um mundo mais saudável, vem sonhar com a gente!

Para sonhar com o nosso apetite de crescimento, precisamos de uma pessoa que tenha experiência ou deseje aprender sobre área de Operações. Alguém que tenha conhecimento, pró atividade e discernimento para, com o passar do tempo, prever e antecipar demandas e próximos passos.

Objetivo

O objetivo é oferecer suporte analítico á diretoria da empresa. Com análises, estudos e acompanhamento de projetos.

Nessa posição

Precisamos de uma pessoa que tenha talento com números. Você será o responsável por dar suporte ao time financeiro, tendo como principais atribuições:

Contas a Pagar e Receber: Auxiliar nos lançamentos de contas a pagar, acompanhar processos de aprovação de despesas, registrar informações no sistema ERP e realizar efetivações bancárias.

title: (Contract) Psychologist
description:
Part-Time Mental Health Therapist (Hybrid: Remote & In-Person)

Location: São José dos Campos, São Paulo, Brazil

City: São José dos Campos, São Paulo

Our mission: to eliminate every barrier to mental health.

Spring Health is the leading comprehensive mental health benefit for employers. We help employees understand their mental health issues and connect with best-in-class providers to get the right treatment at the right time.

From early detection to full recovery, Spring Health is the only clinically validated solution in the market proven to be more effective than traditional mental healthcare. By combining the latest technology with vetted providers, we help engage 1 in 3 employees, reduce recovery times, and lower healthcare costs. We are an award-winning, passionate, and mission-driven team with the support of leaders in psychiatry.

We are seeking qualified, part-time internationally licensed psychotherapists to join our provider network and deliver care with a tech-enabled, AI/machine-learning platform that puts patient outcomes first.

What You'll Do

  • Provide counseling to clients with benefits ranging from short-term goal-focused EAP, to employer health plans allowing as many sessions as medically necessary.
  • Treat adults who have completed brief, evidence-based online screenings identifying their symptoms and areas of concern.
  • Preferably, also be open to treating additional populations such as children, adolescents, couples, or families.
  • Maintain a calendar displaying your availability and complete session documentation in a timely manner within our scheduling system.
  • Use evidence-based treatment modalities and interventions that are tailored to your client’s needs.
  • Collaborate with our dedicated provider support team, our licensed clinical care navigation team, and our administrative care support team whenever you need assistance.
  • Provide culturally competent and empathetic care, upholding our values of diversity and inclusion for all races, ethnicities, and genders.

Who you are

  • You are properly qualified (licensed, if applicable) to practice counseling (as a: Psychologist, Psychotherapist, Clinical Psychologist, Social Worker, etc.) in São Paulo . We are not able to accept applications from anyone requiring clinical supervision.
  • You maintain active professional liability insurance at market rates in your approved jurisdiction (country of licensure).
  • English proficiency requirement: It is required that all global providers speak English at a conversational level and are able to complete a clinical interview and our onboarding process in English. It is not required that all global providers offer therapy sessions in English
  • You have a minimum of 3 years of independent clinical experience.
  • You have access to a computer or laptop, are comfortable with technology, and are tele-health competent.
  • You are available to offer some amount of monthly in-person availability for Spring Health members in São José dos Campos.
  • You have training and experience in evidence-based modalities of care such as CBT, DBT, EMDR, ACT, CPT.
  • You are comfortable with providing safety planning and intervention during situations where a client might present with higher risks.
  • You are committed to quality clinical care and want to expand your capabilities and increase your effectiveness by being informed of client progress or challenges.
  • You like working independently, but would also enjoy having the support of a team and opportunities for connections and collaboration with other providers and our master’s level clinical care navigators.

If you are applying to a hybrid role, please be aware that your own office space will be required.

Why you'll like working with Spring Health

  • You’ll set your own schedule to fit your professional and personal needs.
  • Work from anywhere, as long as you have a confidential, private location with stable internet.
  • No need to spend time marketing your practice, checking insurance eligibility, collecting fees, or submitting claims - we take care of the administrative work so that you can focus on clinical care.
  • Grow your ability to provide effective care through feedback from evidence-based measures that help you identify what is working with your clients.
  • Join a dynamic community where you will be supported, your work appreciated, and you’ll have the opportunity to help us shape the future of mental health care!

In addition to finding people who are truly excellent at what they do, we take our values at Spring Health seriously:

Mission First Removing every barrier to mental health, together.

Move Fast to Change Lives We build with urgency and intention.

Take Ownership We extend trust and hold ourselves accountable.

Embrace Diverse Teams & Perspectives We find strength in the diversity of cultural backgrounds, ideas, and experiences.

Science Will Win We will achieve impact by innovation and evidence based frameworks.

Candor with Care We are open, honest and empathetic.

Spring Health is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable legal requirements. Spring Health is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

title: Network and Systems Administrator
description:
About Playtech

Founded in 1999, the company has a premium listing on the Main Market of the London Stock Exchange and is focused on regulated and regulating markets across its B2B business. By leveraging its proprietary technology, Playtech delivers innovative products and services to ensure a safe, engaging and entertaining gaming experience.

As the gaming industry's leading technology company, it combines business intelligence-driven software, services, content, and platform technology to drive excellence and innovation across the sector. Read more about who we are and what we do here: and

Here at Playtech, we genuinely believe that people are our biggest asset. Diverse thoughts, experiences, and individual characteristics enrich our work environment and lead to better business decisions. Embracing differences and maintaining transparency in our processes is the core of Playtech's overall commitment to responsible business practices.

Ready to grow your career in IT Infrastructure?

We’re looking for a hands‑on, motivated Network & Systems Administrator to support our growing IT environment in Brazil. This is a great opportunity for someone with solid experience who wants to deepen their technical skills, work with modern technologies, and be part of a global, collaborative team.

Job Description

Your Mission: You Will…

  • Support day‑to‑day operations of corporate networks, servers, and IT systems.
  • Configure and maintain LAN, WAN, VPN, and Wi‑Fi networks across offices and datacenters.
  • Install, upgrade, and troubleshoot hardware, software, and infrastructure components.
  • Investigate and resolve IT incidents reported by users, ensuring reliable service delivery.
  • Follow corporate security policies and contribute to maintaining a safe and compliant environment.
  • Assist in IT infrastructure projects, documentation, upgrades, and system improvements.
  • Collaborate with your Team Lead, peers, cross‑functional teams, and external vendors when needed.

Qualifications

What You Need to Succeed

  • Bachelor’s degree in IT or related discipline is desirable but not essential.
  • Proven experience in network/system administration in a corporate environment.
  • Practical knowledge of routing, switching, Wi‑Fi networks and firewalls.
  • Experience with VPN solutions or ZTNA.
  • VMware or alternative vendor virtualisation experience.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS/Azure) – networking/security fundamentals are enough.
  • Good understanding of DNS, user/role‑based access control, and general IT security practices.
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and communicate clearly with global teams.
  • You are fluent in English (written and spoken).

You’ll Stand Out If You Have…

  • Certifications such as Cisco/Juniper, Linux Admin, VMware, or Windows Admin.
  • Hands‑on experience with Meraki devices and Wi‑Fi controllers.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  • A proactive, solution‑oriented mindset and willingness to continuously learn.
  • Experience working in a distributed or multinational environment.

Thrive in a Culture That Values…

  • Learning opportunities and support to grow into more advanced responsibilities.
  • A friendly, collaborative team that shares knowledge and works together across regions.
  • A stable environment where you can build long‑term technical expertise.
  • Flexibility, ownership, and trust in managing your work.
  • A respectful and inclusive workplace where your contribution truly matters.

Additional Information

HOW TO APPLY?

Along with your CV, please submit a short motivation letter outlining your experience in network and systems administration or related IT roles. You can add this directly in the “Message to the Hiring Manager” section when applying.

IT INFRASTRUCTURE TEAM

You’ll be joining a supportive and experienced team responsible for keeping Playtech’s core systems running smoothly. We work with a variety of technologies, collaborate globally, and value teamwork, reliability, and continuous improvement. It’s a great environment to grow your skills while working on meaningful technical challenges.

Playtech is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome everyone and celebrate diversity across our teams.

You will spend most of your day designing, developing and testing your code and supporting your team members. You will be able to deploy your code in production using automated continuous integration and continuous deployment.

You will work with product managers, analysts, architects, and engineers to plan, design, develop, test, and implement information technology solutions.

Hybrid work model, Porto Alegre Office location. It is necessary to live in the region.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

Here's what you can expect on a typical day:

  • We'll start each day with a scrum, working together to understand responsibilities, ID any issues, and communicate coding priorities.
  • Working in two-week sprints, you must keep up with timelines and good coding standards. Your primary responsibility is to deliver features on time.
  • We don't code in a silo. You'll talk to everyone from the project manager to Quality Assurance and current customers to understand requirements and create a collaborative output.
  • We're always learning new codes and investigating open-source communities. Knowing what questions to ask is more important than knowing the right answers.

TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE:

  • Demonstrates advanced understanding and experience on web application development.
  • Advanced English
  • Strong experience of the technologies Java;
  • Know best practices around software development, SDLC, unit testing, frontend performance tuning, be able to share this knowledge with others in the team.
  • Experience using CI and CD pipelines
  • Technical Analysis – analyzing systems, problems, programs, formulating solutions.
  • Technical Design – ensuring that all work undertaken is of sound design and fits in with the existing architecture.
  • Participates in requirements gathering and reviews, assesses technical feasibility, assists in defining solutions, and prepares development artifacts where required.
  • Conducts code walk through and reviews with team members.
  • Monitors changes in technology; remains up to date on current industry trends and internal architecture practices, principles, models and standards; trains technical staff on new technologies.

HOW YOU’LL STAND OUT:

  • Support production software operations, test and debug programs
  • Make a good use of the CI and CD pipeline
  • Self-taught worker: capable of learning and applying by himself
  • Self-guided worker: capable of working with different product teams with little supervision after the initial learning period
  • Strong collaboration skills: ability to establish good relationships with the stakeholders
  • Developer empathy: ability to empathize with developers, by being flexible in solution design without compromising best practices and standards.
  • Improvisation (lateral thinking): the ability to think across disciplines and existing boundaries (technologies/business/geographies)
  • Research: an inclination to continuous research inside and outside of the current focus fields.

title: In-house Engineer
description:
Role: In-house Engineer

Global Opportunities

By joining a team of more than 7,000 people operating in over 60 countries, you will be part of an agile network of talented and ambitious individuals. We count on you to engage, connect, and collaborate with colleagues from around the world. Seize the opportunity to learn, create, and develop your potential with us.

About the Field Service Team

You will be part of the Brazil Field Service team. Our department is responsible for providing first-class field service and support 24/7. By joining us, you will have the opportunity to develop your technical and interpersonal skills through diverse and challenging opportunities.

About the Role: In-house Engineer

As our In-house Engineer, you will be part of a highly qualified team and will be responsible for providing technical and commercial support to our customers directly at their sites.

We currently have four openings available.

Candidates must be based in, or willing to relocate to, one of the following locations

or nearby areas:

  • Nova Lima, MG
  • Santa Bárbara, MG
  • Parauapebas, PA
  • Canaã dos Carajás, PA,
  • Belém, PA

Your Responsibilities

  • Work full-time at designated customer sites.
  • Serve as the FLS focal point at the customer’s site.
  • Coordinate the resolution of all open items between FLS and the customer, ensuring effective and timely closure.
  • Provide on-site basic technical and commercial support to assist customers in achieving maximum operational efficiency with their FLS equipment, including filters, thickeners, flotation cells, crushers, HPGRs, and mills.
  • Monitor the customer’s inventory as well as all other key operational aspects to ensure safe and reliable operations.
  • Relay updated technical and commercial information from the customer site to FLS customer support teams.
  • Support the customer and the FLS team during scheduled and emergency maintenance activities at site.
  • Identify, evaluate, and recommend products, parts, upgrades, and services that best meet customer needs.
  • Ensure the entire sales process aligns with customer requirements,
  • from the initial proposal to final delivery, within the agreed timeframe.
  • Develop strong and effective relationships and communication with customers.
  • Deliver technical and administrative field reports.
  • Maintain and update the CRM system and other control tools.
  • Promote a culture of personal and team/customer safety.
  • Work independently with limited supervision

What You Bring

  • Technical degree or Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Mechatronics Engineering, or a related field.
  • At least 5 years of experience in the mining industry (desirable).
  • Good working knowledge of parts and maintenance of mining equipment such as Thickeners, Flotation Cells, Filters, HPGRs, Mills and Crushers
  • Intermediate English and/or Spanish (desirable).
  • Availability to reside in or near the cities listed above.
  • Availability to travel when required.
  • Strong interpersonal skills.
  • Solid knowledge of MS Office, Outlook, and CRM systems.

What We Offer

  • Market-competitive salary and benefits package
  • Health insurance.
  • Meal vouchers.
  • Bonus program.
  • Private pension plan.
  • Internal and international opportunities to develop your career.

As an equal opportunity employer, FLSmidth embraces diversity and equality, promoting an inclusive environment. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds and perspectives to apply - the more diverse our employees, the stronger our team. In our commitment to equal opportunities and the elimination of prejudice, we ask that you exclude personal information such as age, ethnicity, number of children and photograph from your application materials.

Please note that we will be reviewing applications till March 30th, but the procees is going forward at he same time and can be closed earlier. so please apply as early as possible. Candidates will be contacted by email and phone.

References from unsolicited recruiters or agencies will not be accepted.

All applicants will be required to pass a medical, drug and alcohol test prior to employment.

FLSmidth requires that all individuals have their respective work visas. Otherwise, we will not be able to accept your application.

FLSmidth is the leading supplier of engineering, equipment and service solutions to customers in the mining industry – for more information please visit FLSmidth.com/careers

Role: In-house Engineer

Oportunidades Globais

Ao se juntar a uma equipe de mais de 7.000 pessoas atuando em mais de 60 países, você fará parte de uma rede ágil de profissionais talentosos e ambiciosos. • Desenvolver relacionamentos sólidos e comunicação eficaz com os clientes.

• Elaborar nos prazos necessários os relatórios técnicos e administrativos de campo.

• Manter e atualizar o sistema CRM e outras ferramentas de controle.

• Promover uma cultura de segurança pessoal e de equipe/cliente.

• Trabalhar de forma independente com supervisão limitada.

O Que Você Traz

• Curso técnico ou graduação em Engenharia Mecânica, Elétrica, Mecatrônica ou área relacionada.

• Pelo menos 5 anos de experiência na indústria de mineração desejável).

• Bom conhecimento prático de peças e manutenção de equipamentos de mineração como Espessadores, Células de Flotação, Filtros, HPGRs, Moinhos e Britadores.

• Inglês e/ou espanhol intermediário (desejável).

• Disponibilidade para residir nas cidades listadas acima ou em regiões próximas.

• Disponibilidade para viagens quando necessário.

• Fortes habilidades de comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal.

• Sólido conhecimento em MS Office, Outlook e sistemas de CRM.

O Que Oferecemos

• Salário e pacote de benefícios competitivo em relação ao mercado.

• Plano de saúde.

• Vale-refeição.

• Programa de bônus.

• Plano de previdência privada.

• Oportunidades internas e internacionais para desenvolver sua carreira.

Como empregadora que promove igualdade de oportunidades, a FLS valoriza a diversidade e a equidade, promovendo um ambiente inclusivo. Incentivamos candidatos de todas as origens e perspectivas a se candidatarem — quanto mais diversa for nossa equipe, mais forte ela será. Em nosso compromisso com a igualdade de oportunidades e a eliminação de preconceitos, pedimos que você exclua informações pessoais como idade, etnia, número de filhos e fotografia de seus materiais de candidatura.

Observe que receberemos as candidaturas até 30 de março , porém o processo seguirá em paralelo e poderá ser encerrado antes. Portanto, recomendamos que você se candidate o quanto antes. Os candidatos serão contatados por e-mail e telefone.

Referências de recrutadores ou agências não solicitadas não serão aceitas.

Todos os candidatos deverão passar por exames médicos e testes de drogas e álcool antes da contratação.

A FLSmidth exige que todos os candidatos possuam seus respectivos vistos de trabalho. Caso contrário, não poderemos aceitar sua candidatura.

A FLSmidth é líder no fornecimento de soluções de engenharia, equipamentos e serviços para clientes da indústria de mineração — para mais informações, visite FLSmidth.com/careers .

title: Tecnico de Redes
description:
A Qibit em parceria com empresa de Nova Concessão de Rodovias contrata: Buscamos um(a) Técnico(a) em Redes para atuar presencialmente nas regiões de Juína e Brasnorte (MT) , garantindo segurança, disponibilidade e confiabilidade da infraestrutura de TI, incluindo servidores, redes e sistemas críticos da operação, para atuar em um de nossos clientes — uma empresa de grande porte do setor de infraestrutura e concessões rodoviárias , que atua com gestão, operação e manutenção de rodovias e integra um grupo nacional com forte investimento em sustentabilidade e desenvolvimento. Responsabilidades
  • Configurar, instalar e manter a infraestrutura de TI: servidores, redes, sistemas operacionais e dispositivos de armazenamento.
  • Monitorar desempenho, disponibilidade e conectividade da rede, atuando prontamente na solução de incidentes.
  • Gerenciar contas de usuários, permissões e políticas de segurança.
  • Diagnosticar e resolver problemas técnicos em hardware, software e sistemas operacionais.
  • Executar manutenção preventiva e aplicar atualizações de segurança em servidores e sistemas.
  • Gerenciar rotinas de backup e garantir a integridade e disponibilidade dos dados.
  • Colaborar com equipes internas e fornecedores externos na resolução de problemas complexos de infraestrutura.
  • Fornecer suporte técnico aos usuários finais, orientando, solucionando dúvidas e oferecendo treinamento quando necessário.
  • Documentar procedimentos, políticas e configurações da infraestrutura de TI.
Requisitos Técnicos
  • Formação em Tecnologia da Informação, Ciência da Computação, Redes de Computadores ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência entre 6 meses e 1 ano como Técnico em Redes ou função similar.
  • Conhecimentos em:Administração de sistemas Windows Server e/ou Linux Server
  • Redes: TCP/IP, DHCP, DNS, VPN
  • Segurança da informação
  • Tecnologias de virtualização: VMware / Hyper‑V
  • Experiência com manutenção de infraestrutura, suporte técnico e resolução de incidentes.
  • CNH B obrigatória.
Competências Comportamentais
  • Ética, responsabilidade e conformidade
  • Organização, disciplina e senso de prioridade
  • Comunicação clara e trabalho em equipe
  • Foco em segurança, qualidade e sustentabilidade

title: Analista HRBP Sr
description:
Sobre a empresa

Na Dori | Ferrara, Ferrero, Fox’s Burton’s Companies e The Fine Biscuits Company, somos reconhecidos e amados por pessoas de todas as gerações pela alegria que compartilhamos com elas – uma alegria feita pelas nossas pessoas. Junte-se a nós e descubra um mundo cheio de possibilidades, onde sua paixão encontrará o seu lugar.

A Dori | Ferrara é uma das maiores empresas de doces e snacks do Brasil! Há mais de seis décadas, com um time de mais de 3000 colaboradores, produzimos produtos que acompanham gerações e fazem parte da história e das lembranças de milhões de famílias, com marcas icônicas como Gomets®, Yogurte 100®, Pettiz® e Disqueti®.

Em 2023, iniciamos um novo capítulo ao nos tornarmos parte da Ferrara Candy Company, líder número 1 em balas e gomas nos Estados Unidos, com marcas mundialmente conhecidas como NERDS®, Brach’s®, Jelly Belly®, SweeTARTS®, Laffy Taffy®, and Trolli®. E, na França, a Carambar & Co conquistou gerações de clientes fiéis graças ao apelo atemporal de marcas icônicas de doces e chocolates, como Carambar, Lutti, Krema, Poulain, Vichy e Terry’s.

Com essa união, somos mais de 9.000 colaboradores e uma rede com mais de 30 unidades, garantindo nossa presença global.

Sobre a vaga

O Analista HRBP atuará como parceiro estratégico das áreas de negócio, apoiando líderes em decisões que impulsionem desempenho e alinhamento às prioridades organizacionais. Com abordagem consultiva, trazer visão analítica para temas de pessoas e liderança, fortalecendo capacidades críticas e garantindo que soluções de P&O contribuam diretamente para os resultados das áreas atendidas.

Localidade: São Paulo - SP

Reporta ao: Gerente HRBP

Modelo de trabalho: híbrido

Contamos com você para:

  • Apoiar e influenciar líderes nas decisões de gestão de pessoas, com visão analítica e alinhamento estratégico, atuando como parceiro nas frentes de estrutura, cultura, talentos e mudança. Atuar junto às lideranças na gestão de conflitos, clima, engajamento, desenvolvimento de times e mitigação de riscos trabalhistas.
  • Atuar em parceria com CoEs e DP, garantindo implementação efetiva das iniciativas nas áreas, bem como correta aplicação das políticas, processos e diretrizes corporativas.
  • Apoiar e conduzir ciclos de gestão de desempenho, metas, feedback e planos de desenvolvimento junto às lideranças, além de discussões relacionadas a sucessão, talentos críticos e planos de retenção.
  • Monitorar indicadores (turnover, headcount, orçamento, clima, produtividade etc.), garantindo conformidade, propondo planos de ação e apoiando na construção de análises e apresentações executivas dos temas de pessoas.
  • Liderar a agenda de pessoas em projetos estratégicos das áreas atendidas, assegurando desenho organizacional adequado, planejamento de força de trabalho, mobilização de talentos e implementação sustentável das mudanças.
  • Gestão estratégica do Employee Lifecycle da sua população cliente, atuando de forma ativa e estruturada nas principais etapas da jornada do colaborador — desde atração até desligamento — garantindo qualidade de decisão, experiência consistente e geração de insights para o negócio.

Do que você precisa para fazer a diferença:

  • Formação superior concluída em Administração ou áreas correlatas;
  • Conhecimento ao nível intermediário em Excel é desejável;
  • Inglês ao nível avançado, com habilidades de comunicação oral e escrita, é desejável;
  • Experiência prévia na função, atuando com as áreas de Supply Chain, Go to Market e/ou Corporativo

O que nós oferecemos:

Na Dori | Ferrara, nos orgulhamos de prover aos nossos colaboradores:

  • Programa de Participação nos Resultados (PPR)
  • Assistência médica
  • Assistência odontológica
  • Dr Dori (telemedicina)
  • Seguro de vida
  • Totalpass e/ou Wellhub
  • Vale alimentação
  • Vale refeição
  • Vale Natal
  • Vale transporte
  • Descontos em produtos

Igualdade de Oportunidades

Temos orgulho de ser uma empresa que oferece igualdade de oportunidades e progressão de carreira. Para isso, as decisões e oportunidades de emprego na Dori | Ferrara serão baseadas no mérito, nas qualificações e nas habilidades, independentemente da raça, cor, credo, religião, sexo, orientação sexual, identidade e expressão de gênero, estado civil ou união civil, nacionalidade, ascendência, cidadania, idade, condição de militar ou veterano, deficiência, informações genéticas, gravidez (parto ou condição médica relacionada) ou qualquer outra base proibida por lei.

A Dori | Ferrara não realiza cobranças para a participação de processos seletivos e toda a nossa comunicação é feita através dos canais oficiais da empresa. Se receber qualquer mensagem solicitando pagamento ou dados de cartão de crédito, pedimos que não responda e entre em contato imediatamente com nossos canais oficiais de atendimento (redes sociais ou SAC ).

Em conformidade com a Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD), informamos que todos os dados pessoais fornecidos durante o processo seletivo serão utilizados exclusivamente para fins de recrutamento e seleção. As informações serão tratadas com confidencialidade, segurança e armazenadas apenas pelo período necessário para o processo, sendo posteriormente descartadas de forma segura.

Queremos um mundo de todos, com todos e para todos. Acreditamos na potência de um ambiente que valoriza a diversidade em todas as suas formas de expressão, respeitando a individualidade de cada um. Se você quer sonhar e fazer acontecer, venha ser um Rock Lover!

title: Especialista em infraestrutura Azure
description:
A PSM Company é especializada na identificação de Talentos para as áreas de TI / Telecom como também para as áreas operacionais e administrativas. Nossa história de sucesso, está baseada em nosso modelo de negócios que proporcionam assertividade e qualidade no processo seletivo, baixo Turn Over e isenção de riscos e passivos trabalhistas.

O que Buscamos?

Especialista em infraestrutura Sênior

Descrição:

**Azure Storage – Fundamentos e Arquitetura**

• Arquitetura de conta do Azure Storage e considerações de design;

• Serviços de storage: Blob Storage, Azure Files, Azure Disks, Queue e Table Storage;

• Camadas de desempenho e opções de redundância (LRS, ZRS, GRS, GZRS);

• Planejamento de capacidade, escalabilidade e otimização de custos;

• Gerenciamento do ciclo de vida dos dados e estratégias de tiering;

**Azure Files**

• Arquitetura do Azure Files e protocolos suportados (SMB, NFS);

• Integração de identidade com Azure AD e Active Directory;

• Camadas de desempenho para file share e casos de uso;

• Cenários de migração a partir de file servers on-premises;

• Alta disponibilidade, snapshots e integração com backup;

**Azure Networking – Conceitos Fundamentais**

• Virtual Networks (VNets), subnets e endereçamento IP

• Segurança de rede com NSGs e Azure Firewall

• Padrões de conectividade: VPN Gateway, ExpressRoute

• Private Endpoints e service endpoints

• Conceitos de DNS e resolução de nomes no Azure;

**Monitoramento e Observabilidade**

• Monitoramento de componentes de Azure Storage, Azure Files e Azure Networking;

• Integração com Azure Monitor e Azure Network Watcher;

• Métricas de throughput, latência, disponibilidade e erros;

• Monitoramento de storage accounts, file shares e recursos de rede

Logs e Analytics;

• Integração com Log Analytics Workspace;

• Análise de logs e métricas usando Kusto Query Language (KQL);

• Criação de Workbooks e dashboards para visibilidade da infraestrutura;

• Monitoramento proativo e insights operacionais;

**Backup, Recuperação e Resiliência**

• Conceitos de backup e recuperação para Azure Storage e Azure Files;

• Integração com Azure Backup e Recovery Services Vault;

• Estratégias de snapshot e validação de restore;

• Retenção de dados e requisitos de conformidade;

**Segurança, Governança e Conformidade**

• Melhores práticas de segurança para Azure Storage e Azure Networking

• Criptografia em repouso e em trânsito

• Identidade, controle de acesso e design de RBAC

• Governança com Azure Policy e estratégias de tagging

• Proteção contra exfiltração de dados e misconfiguration

Contratação CLT

Trabalho Hibrido - (Viagens exporaticas a nivel nacional)

O que oferecemos?

  • Vale Refeição ou Alimentação;
  • Assistência Médica e Assistência Odontológica;
  • Auxílio creche;
  • Convênio com Farmácia;
  • Parcerias com Universidades e Escolas de Idiomas;
  • Parceria de descontos com Seguro Auto e Residência;
  • Gympass;
  • Seguro de Vida;

Promovemos um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e acolhedor. Não fazemos distinção por raça, cor, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade. Todas as candidaturas serão consideradas. O seu interesse em participar deste processo seletivo, automaticamente consente, autoriza e concorda que a PSM COMPANY, no papel de CONTROLADORA, tome decisões referentes ao tratamento de seus dados pessoais para esta finalidade específica, em conformidade com a Lei nº 13.709 – Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD).

description:

title: Head of GTM & Growth | Valere Evolve
description:
About Valere Evolve

Valere Evolve is an AI transformation platform that accelerates AI maturity by unifying workforce education, custom development, knowledge capture, and autonomous execution into a single integrated system. Built on three connected pillars — Learn, Build, and Scale — each phase feeds directly into the next. Learning prepares the workforce. Labs builds the systems. Dactic captures institutional knowledge. Conducto orchestrates execution at scale. The result is a continuous transformation loop rather than a stack of disconnected tools and vendors. One platform. From ambition to AI-native operations.

The Role

As Head of GTM & Growth, you are the commercial engine behind Valere Evolve. You will own the full go-to-market strategy and growth execution — from market positioning and pipeline creation to partnership development and revenue scaling. This is not a planning role. You will be expected to build, launch, and iterate in market with the same hands-on urgency that defines the product itself.

You bring demonstrated experience taking AI products and platforms to market, using AI-native tools to scale your own work, and a track record of growing user bases through high-leverage execution. You have done this before. You know what it takes to move a technical platform from early adopters to scaled commercial traction, and you know how to do it with a lean, intelligent team.

This role requires the ability to execute across multiple simultaneous growth motions — and the strategic judgment to know when to lean into each one based on what the market is telling you.

Impact You Will Have

  • Own Market Entry & Expansion: Define and execute the GTM strategy across target segments, verticals, and channels — translating Valere Evolve's platform vision into a repeatable, scalable motion that drives pipeline and accelerates time-to-revenue
  • Build the Growth Engine: Design and personally run the growth infrastructure — outbound sequences, nurture flows, content strategy, and conversion optimization — leveraging AI-native tools to operate at a velocity that outpaces traditional GTM teams
  • Drive Strategic Partnerships: Identify, develop, and close high-leverage partnerships with channel partners, systems integrators, enterprise resellers, and platform ecosystems that unlock distribution and accelerate adoption at scale — structuring agreements that embed platform value directly into partner programs as a retention and growth mechanism
  • Expand from Within: Develop and execute playbooks that convert active client relationships into platform adoption, creating organic expansion from within accounts that are already experiencing Valere's value firsthand
  • Translate Product Into Commercial Narrative: Work closely with product and delivery to develop positioning, messaging, and sales enablement that clearly articulates the value of the Learn → Build → Scale loop to enterprise buyers
  • Convert Strategy to Revenue: Build the frameworks, KPIs, and real-time dashboards that connect GTM activity to pipeline health, conversion rates, expansion revenue, and customer acquisition cost
  • Scale the User Base: Execute demand generation and account-based programs that grow the active user base across direct, partner-led, and paid acquisition channels — with measurable growth targets tied to platform adoption milestones

Key Responsibilities

  • GTM Strategy & Multi-Motion Execution — Own the full go-to-market roadmap including ICP definition, pricing frameworks, and launch execution. You will design and operate across multiple distinct growth motions simultaneously, building the systems to manage, measure, and optimize each one with clarity and speed
  • Partnership Development & Distribution — Source and structure strategic partnerships that create meaningful distribution leverage — including experience embedding platform capabilities and educational content directly into partner programs, proposals, and client engagements. Own the full partnership lifecycle from identification through activation and ongoing revenue contribution
  • Account Expansion & Organic Growth — Build and execute the internal playbooks, enablement materials, and account triggers that convert existing relationships into platform adoption and drive organic growth from within active engagements. Identify the signals that indicate expansion readiness and move on them
  • Targeted Outbound & Enterprise Penetration — Execute precision outbound campaigns targeting key individuals and internal champions inside large organizations. Build the entry-point strategy, manage the champion relationship, and develop the expansion motion that follows initial adoption to grow platform footprint organically from the inside out
  • Paid Acquisition & Influence-Driven Demand — Build and manage a paid acquisition strategy that drives platform awareness and qualified demand at scale — including the identification and activation of credible voices in the AI and enterprise transformation space to amplify reach and accelerate top-of-funnel growth
  • AI-Native Operations — Build and operate GTM workflows using AI-native tools — from prospecting automation and pipeline intelligence to content generation and deal acceleration. You use the tools. You don't delegate the tools.
  • Revenue & Pipeline Ownership — Work directly with sales and leadership to manage pipeline, forecast accuracy, and growth targets. You are accountable to the number.
  • Market Intelligence — Continuously monitor the competitive landscape, buyer behavior, and adoption trends to sharpen positioning and identify untapped growth vectors across all active acquisition channels
  • Cross-Functional Alignment — Serve as the connective layer between product, delivery, and commercial teams — ensuring GTM motion is tightly integrated with product roadmap, customer outcomes, and client-facing team capabilities

What We Look For

  • Experience: 4+ years in GTM, growth, or commercial leadership roles, with at least 2 years of demonstrated experience bringing AI products or platforms to market in a hands-on capacity
  • AI Product GTM (Required): Proven track record of taking AI-native products or platforms from early traction to scaled commercial adoption. You understand the buyer journey, the objections, the trust barriers, and what actually moves enterprise deals forward
  • AI-Native Operator (Required): You actively use and scale your work with AI tools. You have built GTM workflows, systems, and processes powered by AI automation — not as a pilot, but as standard operating procedure
  • Multi-Motion GTM Execution (Required): Demonstrated ability to design and run multiple simultaneous growth motions — partner-led distribution, account expansion, precision outbound, and paid acquisition — and the strategic maturity to resource and prioritize across them as market conditions evolve
  • Partnership Builder: Demonstrated ability to develop and close strategic partnerships that create real distribution leverage — including experience structuring agreements where platform access or educational content is embedded as a core component of the partnership value proposition
  • Account Expansion Experience: Proven ability to convert existing client or customer relationships into product adoption — building the internal plays and triggers that drive organic growth from within active accounts
  • Enterprise Outbound & Champion Development: Hands-on experience running targeted outbound to individual practitioners and decision-influencers inside large organizations, with the ability to build internal champions and develop the expansion motion that follows initial adoption
  • Paid Acquisition & Influencer Marketing: Working knowledge of paid acquisition strategy in B2B and B2B2C contexts, including performance measurement, creator or partner identification, and building programs that sustain organic reach alongside paid investment
  • Strategic Mindset with Execution Bias: You can build the roadmap and execute it in the same week. You are equally comfortable in a board-level positioning conversation and building the outbound sequence that follows it
  • Data-Driven Growth: Fluency in GTM analytics, funnel metrics, and revenue operations. You build dashboards, track what matters, and adjust based on signal — not assumption
  • Communication: Ability to translate complex platform capabilities into compelling narratives for enterprise buyers, partners, and executive stakeholders across every channel and motion
  • Builder Mentality: You don't wait for a team or a budget to grow. You find leverage, build fast, and scale what works
  • Genuine Enthusiasm for AI: Deep curiosity about the evolving AI landscape and a conviction that AI transformation is the defining enterprise challenge of this decade

How to Apply

To be considered for this role, all applicants must submit a brief Loom or video recording (5 minutes or less) shared with , including two things:

  1. A personal introduction — who you are, what drives you, and why this role and this moment in AI transformation excites you
  2. A concrete GTM example — walk us through a specific product or platform you've taken to market. We want the real story: the motion you chose, the obstacles you hit, how you adapted, and the measurable outcome. Slide decks and polished narratives are not what we're looking for. Show us how you think and execute.

Submissions without a video will not be reviewed. We are not evaluating production quality — we are evaluating clarity of thought, commercial instinct, and evidence of hands-on execution.

title: Engenheiro(a) de IA (Generative AI & Agentic Systems)
description:
A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.

Estamos expandindo nosso time de tecnologia e buscamos profissionais para atuar na fronteira da inteligência artificial aplicada aos setores financeiro e securitário. O foco será a construção de ecossistemas inteligentes, indo além de modelos isolados para criar arquiteturas de agentes capazes de resolver demandas complexas de negócio e backoffice.

O DESAFIO:

  • Orquestração e Agentes: Projetar sistemas multiagentes utilizando LangGraph ou Agent Squad para decompor tarefas complexas em workflows automatizados.
  • Observabilidade e Tracing (Prioridade): Implementar o rastreamento completo da "cadeia de pensamento" ( Chain of Thought ) e execução dos agentes.
  • Monitoramento de Performance: Utilizar ferramentas como Langfuse ou LangSmith para monitorar latência, consumo de tokens e qualidade das respostas em tempo real.
  • Desenvolvimento de Ferramentas: Criar conexões seguras entre LLMs e APIs externas via Model Context Protocol (MCP) , garantindo o isolamento e a segurança dos dados.
  • Arquitetura RAG: Otimizar pipelines de recuperação de informação utilizando Vector Stores ( Pinecone ou MongoDB ) para mitigar alucinações e aumentar a precisão contextual.
  • Infraestrutura Cloud: Gerenciar deploys em ambientes AWS ou Azure e integrar modelos via AWS Bedrock ou Azure OpenAI Service , priorizando arquiteturas Serverless e Event-Driven .
  • AI Guardrails: Implementar camadas de filtragem e validação de prompts/outputs para evitar injeções de código ou desvios éticos.
  • Avaliação Sistemática: Desenvolver frameworks de testes (Evals) para validar a eficácia de novas funcionalidades antes do deploy em produção.
  • Eficiência de Custos: Monitorar e otimizar o uso de modelos (Model Routing) para equilibrar performance e custo operacional.

O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA:

  • Linguagens: Domínio avançado de Python e Java para automação de workflows e integraçoes e desenvolvimento de IA.
  • DevOps/MLOps: Experiência com Docker , Containerization e práticas de CI/CD para modelos de linguagem.
  • Educação: Graduação em Engenharia de Computação ou áreas correlatas.

VOCÊ VAI BRILHAR AINDA MAIS SE TIVER:

  • Experiência prévia na construção de assistentes inteligentes escaláveis (ex: via WhatsApp) e pesquisa em Explainable AI (XAI) .

title: Research Engineer, Coding Agents
description:
About Turing

Turing builds large-scale datasets and reinforcement learning (RL) environments that power post-training for the world's leading AI labs and enterprises, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Microsoft AI, Amazon, Apple, and many more. We create RL environments to evaluate and improve our customers' models on complex, multi-step workflows across high-value domains — designing the tasks, reward signals, and verifiers that drive measurable model improvement through RL training.

The Role

We are looking for a Research Engineer, Coding Agents to help deliver frontier-quality datasets, RL environments, and evaluations that improve state-of-the-art coding models and software engineering agents for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.

This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to turn their coding agent improvement goals into concrete data and environment specs — designing tasks that reflect real software engineering work and building the ground-truth systems that verify agent performance.

We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience, ideally combining strong software engineering fundamentals with exposure to ML/AI systems — especially where results depended on data quality, evaluation rigor, or building infrastructure that other engineers rely on.

What You'll Do:

1. Design and deliver datasets and RL environments for coding agents

  • Work with customer researchers to define data requirements for coding agent capabilities: codebase navigation, bug localization, patching, test generation, code reviews, CI-like constraints, refactors, and security fixes.
  • Design task suites that reflect real development work — single-step tasks (fix this bug, write this test) through long-horizon workflows (navigate an unfamiliar repo, diagnose a multi-file issue, produce a reviewed PR).
  • Build ground-truth signals: unit tests, structured checks, automatic validators, and reward functions that verify whether an agent's code actually works.
  • Define environment interfaces — repository structures, dependency contexts, tool schemas — that give agents realistic constraints.

2. Build the quality and validation systems that ensure frontier-grade data

  • Perform deep, detail-oriented audits of produced data — spotting subtle errors, reward hacking opportunities (e.g., agents gaming test suites), leakage, and inconsistent assumptions.
  • Implement automated validation and filtering: deduplication, decontamination, consistency checks, and difficulty/diversity controls.
  • Where appropriate, develop synthetic task generation pipelines: programmatic bug injection, controlled perturbations to existing codebases, and scenario templating across languages and frameworks.

3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs

  • Design and run evals aligned with coding benchmarks and customer-defined capability targets.
  • Produce analysis connecting data to outcomes: pre/post comparisons on targeted coding tasks, error breakdowns, and ablations identifying which data attributes drive model lift on SWE tasks.
  • When needed, run fine-tuning or RL experiments (or partner with research) to demonstrate measurable coding agent improvement.

4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams

  • Provide clear specs, examples, and edge cases to engineers, QAs, and large-scale data production groups.
  • Run fast feedback loops grounded in code quality metrics and automated signals.
  • Review and improve outputs from large-scale task creation efforts, maintaining a high bar for realism and correctness.

Who We're Looking For:

1. Required Qualifications

  • 4–5 years of professional software engineering or ML engineering experience.
  • Python proficiency required; proficiency in one or more additional major languages (C++, Java, Go, Rust, JS/TS) strongly preferred.
  • Strong intuition for what makes a good coding task — realistic difficulty, clear ground truth, and resistance to shortcut solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented: you catch bugs in code that automated tools miss.
  • Experience with testing infrastructure, CI/CD, or code quality systems at a meaningful scale.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning model improvement goals into concrete task specs.

2. Highly valued experience

  • Experience building or evaluating coding agents, copilot systems, or AI-assisted development tools.
  • Familiarity with coding benchmarks (SWE-Bench, HumanEval, or equivalent).
  • RL or post-training work: RLHF, reward modeling, verifier training, or environment design.
  • Experience designing or maintaining evaluation harnesses for ML systems.
  • Comfort with SQL and structured data workflows

Why Turing

  • Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models.
  • Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve.
  • Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.

Values:

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed: We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward: We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.

Advantages of joining Turing:

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours

Don’t meet every single requirement?

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

For applicants from the European Union, please review Turing's GDPR notice here .
